name: Build and test iOS menu
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ios-menu-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Unpack embedded menu source v16
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYCODE'
          import base64, io, zipfile
          payload = ""
          with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(payload))) as archive:
              archive.extractall('.')
          PYCODE
      - name: Tool versions
        run: |
          xcodebuild -version
          xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-version
      - name: Test production aim selection and ray math
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p build dist
          xcrun clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror scripts/aim_core_tests.cpp -o build/aim_core_tests
          build/aim_core_tests | tee dist/aim-core-tests.log
      - name: Build autoload menu dylib (unsigned)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p dist
          bash scripts/build_dylib.sh 2>&1 | tee dist/dylib-build.log
      - name: Install project generator
        run: |
          if ! command -v xcodegen >/dev/null; then
            brew install xcodegen
          fi
          xcodegen --version
      - name: Generate Xcode project
        run: xcodegen generate --spec project.yml
      - name: Build for iPhone (unsigned)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p dist
          xcodebuild -project BRMenu.xcodeproj -scheme BRMenuDemo \
            -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' \
            -derivedDataPath build/device CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO \
            build 2>&1 | tee dist/device-build.log
      - name: Package iPhone outputs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          products=build/device/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos
          test -f "$products/BRMenuDemo.app/BRMenuDemo"
          test -f "$products/DiagnosticMenu.framework/DiagnosticMenu"
          file "$products/DiagnosticMenu.framework/DiagnosticMenu" | tee dist/binary-info.txt
          xcrun lipo -info "$products/DiagnosticMenu.framework/DiagnosticMenu" >> dist/binary-info.txt
          mkdir -p dist/staging/Payload
          ditto "$products/BRMenuDemo.app" dist/staging/Payload/BRMenuDemo.app
          (cd dist/staging && zip -qry ../BRMenuDemo-unsigned.ipa Payload)
          ditto -c -k --keepParent "$products/DiagnosticMenu.framework" dist/DiagnosticMenu-iphoneos.framework.zip
          rm -r dist/staging
          shasum -a 256 dist/BRMenuDemo-unsigned.ipa dist/DiagnosticMenu-iphoneos.framework.zip > dist/SHA256SUMS.txt
      - name: Select an iPhone simulator
        run: |
          xcrun simctl list devices available --json > /tmp/brmenu-simulators.json
          python3 scripts/select_simulator.py /tmp/brmenu-simulators.json >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Run menu UI test
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          xcodebuild -project BRMenu.xcodeproj -scheme BRMenuDemo \
            -configuration Debug -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$BRMENU_SIMULATOR_ID" \
            -derivedDataPath build/simulator -resultBundlePath dist/MenuTests.xcresult \
            CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO test 2>&1 | tee dist/simulator-test.log
      - name: Upload outputs and diagnostics
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: BRMenu-iOS-${{ github.run_number }}
          path: dist/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7
